en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a park with curved paths, lawns, and a waterway. Dominating the scene is a round medieval brick tower (part of old city fortifications). In the background are town buildings and an arched railway bridge. Printed caption at the bottom reads "Kronenburgerpark. — NIJMEGEN." The left margin has vertical publisher text, and the upper right has handwritten text with a date.
